title: EntityConfigScreen
responsibility: The screen of a config: opens on what it provides and who uses it; a config is not pictured, run or heard.

inputs.name: EntityConfigScreen.index
inputs.description: The history index read from index.json: the branches with their head commits, each revision the history lists with its records, coverage and legacy report ids, and the units, benchmarks and profiles it holds. A commit or branch the index does not list is reported as missing, and `truncated` is true when older commits were left out at the build limit.

gaps: no verification record is attached to this commit

inputs.name: EntityConfigScreen.head
inputs.description: The revision of the shown commit, read from `revisions/<commit>.json` and held only while its commit equals the scope's commit. Every contract, measurement and capture on the screen is bound to this revision.

units.title: relayConfig
units.responsibility: Declares operator controls for relay request limits, pairing capacity and device traffic.

inputs.name: EntityConfigScreen.parent
inputs.description: The revision of the selected commit's first parent, which the explorer uses to list the units that commit removed. It is null for a branch address with no commit selected, for a first commit, and when the index does not list that parent.

registry.gap: no unit registry is stored at this revision

inputs.name: EntityConfigScreen.scope
inputs.description: Where the screen is in history: its address (`location`), the branch and its tip, the shown commit and its first parent, and whether that commit is the tip. `mode` is 'current' for an address with no commit and 'commit' for one that names one, and the config pane receives this same scope.

summary.subject: Show config controls in the explorer
summary.author: Example Author

inputs.name: EntityConfigScreen.route
inputs.description: The address shown on the screen, which is `scope.location`: the branch, the commit, the category and, when one is open, the entity with its section and tab. The config pane renders only for an entity whose category is 'configs'.

inputs.name: EntityConfigScreen.entities
inputs.description: The units the explorer lists at this revision, grouped in category order: the active units of `head` that have a category, together with the units the shown commit removed, which are taken from the parent and marked removed. A unit with no category is left out, though relations still name it.

verdict.label: Coverage incomplete
reasons: No scenario covers this unit; tests alone do not show how it behaves.

inputs.name: EntityConfigScreen.lens
inputs.description: The host's readers for entities: `href` builds the full address of a location, and `relations`, `evidence`, `behavior` and `history` answer for a unit. The screen works none of these out itself.

inputs.name: EntityConfigScreen.client
inputs.description: The revision reader: `revision(commit)` loads `revisions/<commit>.json` for one commit. The harness console calls it for the shown commit, and for its first parent only when a commit is selected and the index lists that parent.

inputs.name: EntityConfigScreen.mediaBase
inputs.description: The URL prefix that retained recorded evidence media is served under: the harness console passes its base followed by `/media/`, which is `/harness/media/`. It ends with a slash because each media file's name is added to it by plain concatenation.

inputs.name: EntityConfigScreen.onroute
inputs.description: The host's navigation callback: it takes an explorer location, navigates to its address, and scrolls the page to the top when the category, screen, entity, helper or section changes. A change of tab alone does not scroll.

outputs.name: EntityConfigScreen.configurationOverview
outputs.description: The rendered screen: a `hx-div` marked `harness-entity-config-screen` with `display: contents`, so it draws no box, around the entity frame and its sections. The pane shows the config for an entity whose category is 'configs' and is empty for any other entity.
